summary: Mayor Buenaventura Vivas International Airport (STD/SVSO) serves the city of Santo Domingo, capital of Táchira State in western Venezuela, near the Colombian border. Set in the Andes mountain region, it provides vital air access for this Andean community and surrounding highland areas. The airport is named in honor of a notable local figure and operates as a medium-sized facility handling primarily domestic and limited regional flights.

A: The IATA code is STD and the ICAO code is SVSO.
